info.name: Automation Anywhere API Task Execution AccessDetails TaskData API

params.name: taskName
params.description: Analytics display name of the bot task as configured in the Bot Insight dashboard (e.g., "Analytics_ATM Reconciliation")

items.docs: Retrieves metadata for a specific bot task including its configured KPI variables, data types, and analytics dimensions. The task name must match the Analytics display name configured in the Bot Insight dashboard for the task.

params.name: taskName
params.description: Analytics display name of the bot task as configured in the Bot Insight dashboard (e.g., "Analytics_ATM Reconciliation")

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the date range in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: to
params.description: End of the date range in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Must not be more than 60 days after the from date.

items.docs: Retrieves the variable profile (analytics KPI data) for a specific bot task within a given date range. Returns aggregated values for each KPI variable tracked during bot execution. Dates are provided as query parameters in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: taskName
params.description: Analytics display name of the bot task as configured in the Bot Insight dashboard (e.g., "Analytics_ATM Reconciliation")

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Zero-based record index for pagination. Set to 0 to retrieve the first page of 1000 records, then increment by 1000 for subsequent pages.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for the data query in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

items.docs: Retrieves detailed execution log data for a specific bot task, including per-run KPI variable values. Results are paginated at 1000 records per request starting from the given index. Used to extract raw bot analytics data for integration with external BI tools and data warehouses.
